$comment: Sensitive-field vocabulary and national-id value shapes. A `name` case names a field and carries the `canary` planted behind it; a `value` case is its own canary, because the shape is the secret. `expect` is "redacted" when the canary must appear in no byte of any output and "visible" when it must survive - the false-positive half is the half that keeps the default switched on. See README.md.
